scheme_name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar State Award To SC/ST/OBC/Minorities Students
other_conditions: The student must have passed 10th and 12th class from Delhi
The award is given to a student who tops among the SC/ST/OBC in each discipline of the professional/technical degree course
The topper student is awarded only once after passing out of the final examination of the course
The award is conferred among the toppers of all professional/technical courses
benefits_summary: A cash award of INR 25,000 to each student who tops among SC/ST/OBC/Minorities in a professional/technical discipline
documents_required: SC/ST/OBC caste certificate issued by the competent authority of Delhi
